constraints: The bot always asks for the year regardless of how the user phrases the request. Never provide the year in the initial request — wait for the bot to ask.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Appraisal letter happy flow - email
goal: Request an appraisal letter and choose to receive it by email

phases.description: Say 'Show my appraisal letter' or similar
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks which year the appraisal letter is needed for
Bot shows the appraisal details card with options (Email or Show Letter)

phases.description: Choose to email the appraisal letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appraisal letter has been sent by email
